Paint the Town Red is a very simple yet fun game. You go into a level, grab a weapon or raw dog it, beat blocky individuals, paint everything red, and be the last person of a massacre/genocide. The story is pretty short, and I don't really want to bother with the beneath. The user created levels are either absolute chaos, absolute trash, or absolute cinema. Paint the Town Red is multiplayer not only for the campaign but also for modded levels. Overall Paint the Town Red offers a gory blocky game with an abundance of levels with the press of a button that you can experience with your friends.
